title: Complaint of Moo S. Lim, et al. vs. Korean Capital Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC ruled the complaint moot because of decisions in Cases 2000-9 and 2001-8. No merits ruling, relief, or further proceedings are stated.
first_summary: The SJC dismissed Moo S. Lim and others’ complaint against Korean Capital Presbytery as moot because of its decisions in Cases 2000-9 and 2001-8.
summary: The SJC ruled Moo S. Lim and others’ otherwise-unspecified complaint against Korean Capital Presbytery moot because of decisions in Cases 2000-9 and 2001-8. The brief entry gives no merits ruling, relief, or explanation of those prior decisions. Although the combined catalog header also says “dismissed,” the operative entry for Case 2001-36 states only that it was moot.
